name: RALMP — Rural Agricultural Linkage Management Program

direction.title: Agri Precision
direction.summary: A modern, editorial agri-tech system: high-contrast type, generous whitespace, hairline structure and a restrained emerald + lime + amber signal palette. Marketing surfaces feel editorial; product surfaces feel engineered — dense, calm and operational.
avoid: oversized display copy on product screens

typography.notes: Display 700/800 with -0.02em tracking for editorial headings. Body Inter 400/500/600. Numbers use tabular-nums in tables and metrics.

structure.publicShell: Sticky translucent top nav + 3-column editorial footer.
structure.productShell: Role-aware left sidebar + sticky top bar with search, notifications and user menu; content in a max-w container.
structure.density: Product surfaces use a 4px spacing grid, hairline 1px borders (rgba(7,22,15,.08)) and shadow-sm cards.

components: Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Field/Help/Error
Card & Panel, StatCard, SectionHeading, Badge/Chip, Tag
Avatar & AvatarGroup, Tabs, SegmentedControl, Modal, Drawer/Sheet
Table (sticky header, zebra-free, hairline rows), Pagination, Breadcrumbs
EmptyState, Skeleton, Spinner, ProgressBar, Timeline, Toaster (sonner)

accessibility.contrast: Body text >= 4.5:1 on canvas; interactive focus uses a 4px brand ring.
accessibility.semantics: Landmarks (header/nav/main/footer), labelled icon buttons, visible focus.

decisions.decision: Full visual redesign of the React frontend using the 21st.dev build workflow; introduce a role-aware sidebar product shell distinct from the public marketing shell.
